resources.string: Asks you to approve when someone wants to see this phone\'s camera.
%1$s wants to see this phone\'s camera. Tap to choose, or ignore to decline.
%1$s will see a live view from the camera and can take photos and video clips until you tap Stop.
%1$s will see and hear a live view from the camera and microphone, and can take photos and video clips until you tap Stop.
Each session needs you to approve it on the phone; the camera can\'t be opened unattended. While it is shared a notification with Stop stays visible.
Camera access is granted. Allow the microphone too if clips should have sound.
Camera and microphone access are granted.
Allow camera access so the web Camera tab can ask to use it.
